articles.title: Trump to press Zelenskyy for energy truce, says Russia has ‘lost control’ of oil due to Ukraine war
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Russia has “lost control” of its diesel oil industry due to the Ukraine war, as he presses Kyiv to agree to an energy truce.

articles.title: Soccer superstar Kylian Mbappé on ending 20-year journey with Nike: 'It was time to change'
articles.description: Soccer Champion Kylian Mbappé said he was ready for "change" after ending his association with Nike and entering a deal with Swiss sportswear brand On.

articles.title: Oil rises amid worries of growing Iran-U.S. tensions after Bessent issues Iranian airline shutdown warning
articles.description: Oil rose Tuesday, amid concerns of growing Iran-U.S. tensions. after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that all Iranian airlines will be shut down from Wednesday.

articles.title: Crypto’s wild boom-and-bust cycles are fading, Solstice CEO says
articles.description: Solstice CEO Ben Nadareski says deeper liquidity and growing institutional participation could make future crypto bull runs less volatile than previous cycles.

articles.title: U.S. threatens to 'shut down' Iranian airlines as Houthis tighten pressure on oil route
articles.description: The Treasury Secretary said that Washington was pressuring Iran "like never before"

articles.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
articles.description: Inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs picked up Monday as bitcoin rallied to its highest since January.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs flirt with $1B as inflows hit 2026 high
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion on Monday, their largest daily inflow since October 2025, as Bitcoin briefly climbed above $87,000.

articles.title: India's large caps stuck in 'bygone economic era', says Bernstein, as foreign investors head for the exit
articles.description: Global brokerage Bernstein said foreign investors had little reason to invest in India as large businesses were struggling to reinvent themselves.

articles.title: Animoca puts Currenc merger on ice, delaying its Nasdaq debut
articles.description: Animoca Brands suspended its reverse merger talks with Currenc but said it remains committed to pursuing a listing on a major exchange.

articles.title: Whitehats move 52 bitcoin from the Coldcard hack to a recovery trust
articles.description: According to Galaxy Digital, the good guys have moved 52 BTC to an address carrying an OP_RETURN message reading "claim:cryptorecoverytrust dot com."

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Australian 40-year economic outlook recognizes ‘AI revolution,’ omits crypto
articles.description: Treasury named AI among five major transitions expected to reshape Australia’s economy, while Coinbase says the report overlooks the digital financial infrastructure AI agents could eventually need.

articles.title: Elon Musk's X brings bitcoin and stock trading closer to the timeline
articles.description: Elon Musk’s X lets U.S. users tap cashtags such as $BTC to view live charts and access Coinbase, Kraken and other trading platforms.

articles.title: Alibaba shares jump as new AI chip, data center buildout plans unveiled
articles.description: Alibaba shares jumped 3% in Hong Kong on Tuesday as the tech giant unveiled a new AI chip and plans to sharply expand its global data center capacity

articles.title: U.S. strikes Greenland deal for 'permanent control over security,' will send forces to Danish dog-sled outpost and reopen Cold War base: report
articles.description: Trump said the agreement with Greenland and Denmark would give the U.S. "permanent control over security" in the Danish island territory.

articles.title: Dogecoin leads market rebound with 15% pump, bitcoin steady above $85,000
articles.description: A wave of forced buying that cost short sellers $844 million has run its course, leaving the largest cryptocurrency flat over the past hour and ZEC the only major token in the red.

articles.title: Cardano joins Solana, XRP Ledger in race to power AI agent payments
articles.description: The official x402 kit now includes Cardano tools for apps and AI agents to pay with ADA and other network tokens, though the facilitator has so far only been tested on pre-production.

articles.title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
articles.description: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.

articles.title: Investors rush into India’s National Stock Exchange IPO at valuation multiple above Nasdaq
articles.description: The $2.3 billion NSE IPO, India's largest public share sale issue so far this year, has drawn strong interest from investors, with bids of more than $10 billion.

articles.title: Taiwan benchmark Taiex rises to record intraday high as tech stocks advance
articles.description: Taiwan's benchmark Taiex rose to a record intraday high Tuesday, driven by gains in the tech sector, following an AI-driven rally on Wall Street.
